# qrcode-generator 1.4.4

QR Code Generator for JavaScript, by Kazuhiko Arase. MIT license (see the header of `qrcode.js`).
Source: https://github.com/kazuhikoarase/qrcode-generator (npm `qrcode-generator`).

Dox POS uses it to draw, in the browser, the QR code that connects the phone app. Nothing is sent
to any server to make it.
